hook:
pick a card.
this is what december is bringing you
sub: trust the first one your eyes went to

piles.title: something stuck finally moves
piles.text: the thing that's been frozen since summer starts moving. you'll have to pick a direction. stop waiting for a sign: this is it.

piles.title: your people come back
piles.text: december gets social. a reunion, a dead group chat comes back to life, someone you haven't seen in years. go.

piles.title: a lucky turn you didn't plan
piles.text: a random invite, a last-minute change, a door you didn't knock on. say yes before you overthink it.

cta:
comment 1, 2 or 3
and come back in january to tell me
